```ts
  interface IntrinsicElements {
    foo: { requiredProp: string; optionalProp?: number }
  }
}
class React {  static Render(a?: any, b?: any, c?: any) {} }

  <foo />;
}
```
2.ts
```ts
export default class Test {}
```
command line
``` tsc 1.tsx --jsx react```

```error TS2322: Type '{}' is not assignable to type '{ requiredProp: string; optionalProp?: number; }'.

```

**Actual behavior:**
compilation is success

**Note:**  
if I comment line 'import Test from "./2"', I get error as expected.
